title: Power Systems — Federated Battery Architecture
description: Energy transduction, voltage topology, SoC estimation, and federated power routing for wearable and vehicle power systems. 7 micrograms + 3 chains covering physics through BMS firmware logic.

tools.name: classify-transducer
tools.description: Classify a physical transducer by energy domain mapping (mechanical/thermal/optical/chemical/electromagnetic/acoustic/nuclear → electrical/mechanical/thermal/optical/acoustic). Returns transducer class, device examples, primitive formula, efficiency range, and conservation note. 17 classes covered.

parameters.name: input_energy
parameters.description: Input energy domain: mechanical, thermal, optical, chemical, electromagnetic, acoustic, nuclear

parameters.name: output_energy
parameters.description: Output energy domain: electrical, mechanical, thermal, optical, acoustic

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Physical scale: nano, micro, macro, industrial

tools.name: calculate-casimir-energy
tools.description: Compute Casimir extractable energy for parallel plate geometry. E/A = -π²ℏc/(720·d³). Routes by gap size to determine practical feasibility class. Covers sub-nm to macro regimes.

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: Plate material: ideal_conductor, gold, silicon, graphene, metamaterial

tools.name: query-vacuum-energy-discrepancy
tools.description: The 10^120 vacuum energy discrepancy — worst prediction in physics. Compare QFT prediction vs cosmological observation vs Casimir measurement across 4 UV cutoff scales (Planck, electroweak, QCD, SUSY).

parameters.name: framework
parameters.description: Theoretical framework: qft, cosmological, casimir, all

parameters.name: cutoff_scale
parameters.description: UV cutoff for QFT: planck, electroweak, qcd, susy

tools.name: evaluate-voltage-topology
tools.description: Evaluate bus voltage topology for wearable/vehicle power systems. Routes by voltage level and computes wire gauge, insulation weight, motor efficiency, and touch safety. 5 regimes: SELV (<60V) through extreme (>500V).

parameters.name: max_power_kw
parameters.description: Maximum continuous power demand in kilowatts

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: Operating environment: wearable, vehicle, stationary, aerospace

tools.name: estimate-soc
tools.description: State-of-Charge estimator using fused EKF + OCV + coulomb counting. Routes by available sensor data quality. Handles thermal override (>60°C), cold deration (<0°C), heavy load, and regeneration modes.

parameters.name: load_state
parameters.description: Current load: resting, light_load, moderate_load, heavy_load, regenerating

tools.name: route-power-load
tools.description: Route power demand to the correct energy tier in a federated battery architecture. 4 tiers: main NMC (bulk), ultracap (burst), per-limb LFP (local), aux LFP (life-critical emergency).

parameters.name: locality
parameters.description: Which zone: left_arm, right_arm, left_leg, right_leg, torso, distributed

parameters.name: main_bus_status
parameters.description: Main bus health: nominal, degraded, failed

tools.name: schedule-limb-charge
tools.description: Schedule per-limb buffer charging from main bus. Prioritizes lowest-SoC limb. Throttles when bus load rises. Prevents simultaneous all-limbs-charging bus overload.
